note: Digest substitution — the cheapest lie available to a proposer. Two tuples identical in every human-readable field (same loadout kind, same NAME 'alpha') and differing only in the loadout's content digest MUST have different tuple digests, or a proposer could swap the loadout contents under a well-regarded name and inherit its outcome history. Nothing in this package inspects what a loadout DOES (substrate §9); the digest is the whole of what it IS, so the digest must be load-bearing in the identity.
